content.text: {"route":"review","reason":"The record summary lists 15 detailed incidents and confirms a completed ROI, notice of hearing rights, and an FAD under 1614.110(b). It does not show what evidence the investigation gathered: no witness statements from Supervisors 1 and 2, the Chief, the Program Manager, or coworkers; no comparator information on cashier or light duty assignments; no light duty documentation or medical records; and no account of the agency's stated reasons. The agency's finding of no disparate treatment is stated without any supporting analysis, and hostile work environment, age, and disability accommodation theories are not addressed. Because this is only a background summary, the ROI may be fuller than described, so adequacy cannot be confirmed and a closer human look at the full ROI is needed."}
